assessment: Drosophila Kenyon cells dendrites in the mushroom body calyx receive inputs from the projection neurons (PNs) in the antennal lobe. This work shows that potential variability of olfactory responses in Kenyon cell post synapses is reduced by the activity of a widely arborizing inhibitory interneuron named APL. APL also receives inputs from PNs and provides local scaled GABAergic feedback to PN-Kenyon cell synapses to normalize postsynaptic responses in the calyx.
